title: Throttle heatmap runner for core models (tokens/sec fidelity + p95 tomography)
creator: Ava Patel
description: We need a robust microbenchmark runner that maps tokens/sec behavior across core models into an operational heatmap and emits time-series p95 signals for regression detection. The existing TPS suites focus on single-shot throughput and steady-state probes; this ticket builds a complementary runner that sweeps input length, batch size, and prefix-warm states to produce a heatmap of throughput vs. latency characteristics and persistent p95 telemetry. This will help us triage regressions caused by kernel swaps, quantization changes, and runtime scheduling policies. Deliverables: a reproducible runner (k8s job + local mode), standardized corpus and prom-label schema, Grafana panels and alert rules, CI integration for nightly baselines, and an automated bisect flow that narrows suspect commits when p95 drifts are detected.
acceptance_criteria: Runner can execute a configurable sweep of (model, batch_size, seq_len, kv_warm) and emit tokens/sec and per-request latency histograms to Prometheus/Grafana
Nightly baseline job runs in CI and stores baseline artifacts (CSV + JSON) in s3://redwood-benchmarks/heatmap/ and exposes a regression diff report
p95 regression alert rule in Grafana/Alertmanager that triggers when p95 increases by >15% vs baseline for two consecutive runs
Run artifacts include reproducible command lines and seed values; at least three core models are supported (gpt-small-quant, gpt-medium-fp16, redwood-compat-1.0)
Automated bisect helper script that can pick a narrowed commit window and run the failing sweep with identical config
implementation_steps: Design YAML config schema for sweeps (model, batch, seq_len, kv_warm, warmup_iters, sample_iters)
Implement runner in Go (prefers existing benchmark harness) with local Docker mode and k8s Job mode
Instrument runtime to expose per-request timing and tokens/sec counters with labels (model, host, batch, seq_len, kv_warm)
Add prometheus exporter and histogram buckets tuned for p50/p95/p99 visibility
Create Grafana dashboards (heatmap + timeseries) and Alertmanager rule for p95 drift
Integrate nightly CI job that snapshots baselines and stores artifacts in S3; link to PR checks for regressions
Write bisect helper and document triage playbook; include roll-forward/rollback steps
milestones: M4: Bisect helper + documentation and handoff (2025-03-28)
